_template_note: FLUX.2 [klein] 4B text-to-image on the Unified Engine. Three phases: (TE) Qwen3-4B text encoder, 27 of 36 layers, hidden-state taps at layers 9/18/27 -> 7680-wide prompt embedding; (DiT) 5 double-stream + 20 single-stream blocks, 4 Euler flow-matching steps statically unrolled into one program; (VAE) AutoencoderKLFlux2 decoder run layer-by-layer through the conv/GroupNorm drivers (needs the CONV2D queue-config image). The TE and DiT weight images time-share the params arena (phased layout, everything below the 4 GiB DMA address limit); tensors persist across phases so the prompt embedding and latents never leave DRAM.

fixed_isa_regs._note: The rest of the fixed GPR map is built per program by Flux2KleinEngine._prime_regs: per-engine row counts (names ending in _e) and full counts, all <= 14 so every bulk op runs the dynamic (PBI) core; dynamic allocation starts at 15.

quantization._note: IF4 = per-64-block min-MSE INT4/FP4 (scale sign selects the codebook, quant_lib.quantize). bf16_keys stay BF16 B-operands: embedders, the timestep MLP, the shared modulation projections and the output head (small, and their outputs scale every token). VAE convs are IF8 per (oc, tap, 64-ch block).

dram_layout._note: params arena 2.5 GiB (DiT image 2.34 GB; TE image 1.45 GB time-shares it), tensors 1 GiB at 0xA0000000 (~100 MB at 256x256, ~430 MB at 512x512 with 8 per-engine attention scratches), then 8 per-engine program slots of 64 MiB (engine e at 0xE0000000 + e*0x04000000; TE+DiT programs are 43 MB on one engine, <10 MB per engine on eight). Everything below 0x100000000 (32-bit DMA address).

defaults.prompt: A photo of a red sports car on a mountain road at sunset
